blockingIssues.description: Working tree has uncommitted reversions of airr.py that remove the entire unified pipeline implementation (135 lines deleted including _resolve_database_via_reference and _get_reference_yaml_path). The committed code at bdd4c1a2 and HEAD (094f70ed) is correct, but the current working tree breaks 6+ tests. The working tree also reverts cli.py (152 lines removed) and app.py changes from the cli-rebuild-update feature. These reversions must be discarded (git checkout -- src/sadie/airr/airr.py src/sadie/germlines/cli.py src/sadie/app.py) to restore the committed implementation.

Species name mismatch: The auto-generated reference.yml uses 'macaque' (from IMGT source directory) but the germlines igblast module uses 'rhesus_macaque'. The fallback exception handler in _resolve_database_via_reference catches (ValueError, RuntimeError, FileNotFoundError) but NOT BadDataSet, so Airr('rhesus_macaque') raises an uncaught BadDataSet instead of falling back. Fix: either add BadDataSet to the exception tuple in the fallback handler, or add a species name alias mapping.

New pyright error in germlines/__init__.py:153 - 'Path' is not defined. This was introduced by the unified-pipeline milestone (likely the cli-rebuild-update feature). Needs a 'from pathlib import Path' import at the top of germlines/__init__.py.
